name: Orrery: sphere, clipped sphere, annulus, raised disk, triangles, icosahedron, tiny spheres
description: A ringed planet (sphere + tilted annulus), an open lantern (sphere clipped by zmin, zmax and phimax), a disk raised by 'height', a 20-triangle gem, a comet (sphere + thin triangle), a non-planar kite and stars only a few pixels wide. Checks every primitive's intersection and the perspective camera at sub-pixel level.
